title: Lula Addresses UN General Assembly for the 10th Time, a Historic Milestone
detail: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva addressed the United Nations General Assembly for the 10th time, a notable milestone. His remarks focused on multilateralism, Brazil's global positioning, and key diplomatic themes for 2026, reinforcing Brazil's role as a major voice in international forums.
